sources.note: Schuko article (opened, CEE 7/4 plug): line and neutral pins 4.8 mm diameter, 19 mm long, centres 19 mm apart; the earth contacts are flat areas on the top and bottom of the plug (no size given). ESTIMATES: round body 35 mm diameter (it must fit the 36 mm recess of the socket model), 60 mm overall length with the cable boot, earth strips 10 x 12 mm. The mating face z = 0 is the pins tips.
